title: A Multicenter Real-life Study of Disseminated Borreliosis Cases Occurring in Patients Receiving Anti-CD20 Treatment in France
official: A Multicenter Real-life Study of Disseminated Borreliosis Cases Occurring in Patients Receiving Anti-CD20 Treatment in France
summary: Clinical, biological, radiological, and pharmacological description of cases of disseminated borreliosis (Borrelia burgdorferi sl. and Borrelia miyamotoi) occurring in patients who received drug treatment based on anti-CD20 monoclonal antibodies.
criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* Minor or adult subject
* Having presented disseminated borreliosis confirmed by molecular biology (Borrelia burgdorferi sl. or Borrelia miyamotoi) within 24 months of receiving treatment with an anti-CD20 monoclonal antibody between January 1, 2010, and July 30, 2025.

Exclusion Criteria:

\- Refusal to participate in the study

sites.f: Laboratoire de Bactériologie - CHU de Strasbourg - France
